title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.33233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier AI models are increasingly deployed on topics where the stakes are high and expert judgment is required, including healthcare, defense, finance, governance, and politics. We present a general methodology for distilling expert human judgment into automated evaluation systems that operate at scale. Our approach assembles networks of domain experts and develops techniques for extracting not just their conclusions but their reasoning processes, encoding those processes into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. We ground our approach in a long tradition of research on the nature of expertise and the conditions under which expert judgment is reliable and more effective than other approaches, and argue that independent, expert-calibrated evaluation is necessary not only on epistemic grounds but as a matter of accountability and public trust. translated_abstract: 前沿人工智能模型越来越多地被部署在高风险且需要专家判断的领域，包括医疗保健、国防、金融、治理和政治等。我们提出了一种通用方法，将人类专家判断蒸馏到可大规模运行的自动化评估系统中。我们的方法组建领域专家网络，并开发相关技术，不仅提取专家的结论，还提取其推理过程，并将这些过程编码为结构化的编辑标准，供自动化评审系统持续应用。我们的方法建立在关于专业知识本质以及专家判断在何种条件下可靠且比其他方法更有效的长期研究传统之上，并论证了独立且经专家校准的评估不仅在认识论层面是必要的，也是关乎问责和公众信任的问题。我们以AI新闻报道为应用场景验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种通用方法，通过构建专家网络并提取专家的结论与推理过程，将其编码为结构化编辑标准，从而把人类专家判断蒸馏进可大规模运行的自动化评估系统，并以AI新闻报道为例进行了验证。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a general methodology for distilling expert human judgment—including experts' reasoning processes—into structured editorial standards for scalable automated evaluation systems, validated on AI news reporting.
